# jans_lock_configuration (Resource)

Resource for managing the Jans Lock plugin configuration. This resource cannot be created or deleted, only imported and updated.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `audit_persistence_mode` (String) Audit persistence mode. Possible values are internal and config-api.
- `base_dn` (String) Base DN of the Lock configuration.
- `base_endpoint` (String) Base endpoint of the Lock server.
- `cedarling_configuration` (Block List, Max: 1) Cedarling engine configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--cedarling_configuration))
- `clean_service_batch_chunk_size` (Number) Each clean up iteration fetches a chunk of expired data per base dn and removes it.
- `clean_service_interval` (Number) Time interval for the clean up service in seconds.
- `client_id` (String) Client id used by the Lock server.
- `client_password` (String, Sensitive) Client password used by the Lock server.
- `disable_external_logger_configuration` (Boolean) Whether to disable the external log4j2 configuration override.
- `disable_jdk_logger` (Boolean) Boolean value specifying whether to enable JDK Loggers.
- `error_reason_enabled` (Boolean) Whether error reasons are returned in responses.
- `external_logger_configuration` (String) Path to an external logging configuration.
- `grpc_configuration` (Block List, Max: 1) gRPC transport configuration of the Lock server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--grpc_configuration))
- `logging_layout` (String) Logging layout used by the Lock server.
- `logging_level` (String) Logging level for the Lock server.
- `message_consumer_type` (String) Message consumer type.
- `metric_reporter_enabled` (Boolean) Boolean value specifying whether to enable Metric Reporter.
- `metric_reporter_interval` (Number) The interval for metric reporter in seconds.
- `metric_reporter_keep_data_days` (Number) The days to keep report data.
- `open_id_issuer` (String) OpenID issuer used by the Lock server.
- `protection_mode` (String) Token protection mode. Possible values are oauth and cedarling.
- `stat_enabled` (Boolean) Whether statistics collection is enabled.
- `stat_timer_interval_in_seconds` (Number) Interval of the statistics timer in seconds.
- `token_channels` (List of String) Message channels the Lock server listens on for tokens.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--cedarling_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cedarling_configuration`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the Cedarling engine is enabled.
- `external_policy_store_uri` (String) URI of an external policy store.
- `log_level` (String) Cedarling log level.
- `log_type` (String) Cedarling log type.
- `max_entries` (Number) Maximum number of entries kept in the Cedarling log store.
- `policy_sources` (Block List) Policy stores consumed by Cedarling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--cedarling_configuration--policy_sources))

<a id="nestedblock--cedarling_configuration--policy_sources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cedarling_configuration.policy_sources`

Optional:

- `authorization_token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token used to retrieve the policy store.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this policy source is enabled.
- `policy_store_uri` (String) URI of the policy store.



<a id="nestedblock--grpc_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `grpc_configuration`

Optional:

- `grpc_port` (Number) Port the gRPC server listens on.
- `server_mode` (String) gRPC server mode. Possible values are disabled, bridge, plain_server and tls_server.
- `tls_cert_chain_file_path` (String) Path to the TLS certificate chain file.
- `tls_private_key_file_path` (String) Path to the TLS private key file.
- `use_tls` (Boolean) Whether the gRPC server uses TLS.
